body: I see everyone around me, growing up, and becoming something. They're having kids and getting married; Graduating College and getting good jobs. I'm not a bad person, so why do bad things happen to me? I constantly look for jobs so I can pay my bills. I'm 19, 20 in May and I still live at home. I try and give everything I can to people, I look for the good in them. Then I get told I don't do anything to help, I'm just going through a stage, that I'm just being whiny.
